title: The Hotel
content: Has anyone been to The Hotel? The lobby is quite elaborate, with gold and maroon colours featured, and a multitude of elevators. I always seem to be in an elevator trying to get to a floor really high up near/on the roof or mezzanine, and avoiding someone who I feel like is following me. Sometimes I’ll end up in a room and there are usually others belongings in it and it hasn’t been cleaned. Sometimes I’ll wind up just outside the hotel, on a lit walkway near a dark lake. It’s always nighttime. I’ve been to a few motels where the rooms are small and a bit dingy and close together. But The Hotel seems to be a place I am the most, constantly riding the elevator.
